verdict.rationale: Steel documents a debug URL for human-in-the-loop workflows in which users can directly interact with and control browser sessions, and it links an Embed Sessions page. This covers the core of human takeover. The evidence does not explicitly show live watching of a running session, or how control passes from the agent to a human mid-run and back again. missing for 10: explicit documentation of live session viewing, a documented mid-run pause/handoff and resume-to-agent flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the takeover experience.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can watch a session live and take human control mid-run when the agent gets stuck

citations.quote: Steel's debug URL feature allows you to implement human-in-the-loop workflows where users can directly interact with and control browser sessions.
